bibl.title: Giuseppe Fraccaroli e le postille a Il metodo critico del Prof. Girolamo Vitelli.
bibl.seg: Francesco Pagnotta, Giuseppe Fraccaroli e le postille a Il metodo critico del Prof. Girolamo Vitelli.
bibl.note: Giuseppe Fraccaroli's annotations to his copy of Il metodo critico del Prof. Girolamo Vitelli preserved at the Civic Library of Verona are published here: written at the end of 1917, they confirm the many prejudices about Vitelli and his relations with German culture.
